svg.aria-label: Iskariot — AI Systems Engineer. Animated schematics of the serving and agent stack.
svg.title: Iskariot — AI Systems Engineer
svg.desc: Animated schematic plates: cold-start, grouped-gemm, super-weight, self-filling-cache, determinism, roofline, attention-crossover, tensor-core-dark, boundary, moe-dispatch, knee. Illustrations of how these mechanisms behave — not benchmark results.
